newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MMK Q1 1997 operating profit down 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: MMK Q1 1997 operating profit down 9 pct.

text.p: Austria's cartonboard maker Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG (MMK) said on Thursday operating profit in the first quarter of 1997 fell nine percent but remained upbeat the second quarter would be better.
MMK said operating profit fell to 218 million schillings from 240 million in the first quarter of 1996.
MMK said prospects were good for the first half due to a stabilisation in raw material costs and a good order situation.

"The condition of the market for recyled cartonboard is seen as robust due to continuous demand in and outside Europe. There is therefore the expectation of firmer prices and a sustained good result in the second quarter," MMK said in a statement.
Sales eased to 2.581 billion schillings from 2.750 billion a year ago, while earnings per share were down at 10.7 schillings from 12.7 schillings in the year-ago-period, the company said.
